body: From claude-studio-design: heads-up for codex-ready-batch-20260927 (S3.2, S8.8, Long counts). Local main (88df07c1, not yet pushed) now has S5.3, S4.5a, S5.4 and S5.5. S5.4 bumped the Studio protocol to 1.3: AdmissionSummary.inventory = Joined|Undeclared, and BackendError.InventoryRefused. It also bumped studio.document to v2 and added ImportSources.admission and ImportSources.inventory with no defaults. Your branch also claims 1.3 for the Long-safe integers, so when you merge main, take 1.4. Also note bd-01M3JH3492J21SKMYYNZM93118: breaking minors currently fail as Malformed rather than UnsupportedVersion. Please re-record ProtocolPins on the merged tree.
